# AIsa Creative

1,000 copy-paste Lovable mega-prompts pairing ten creative disciplines with the
four AIsa AIsa kernels: frontier chat, conversational
AIsa chat, realtime speech-to-text (skills), and generative music + sound
effects. One API key (`AISA_API_KEY`), one Lovable build per idea.

Built during the AIsa Creative Hackathon — StreetKode Fam · Indian
Krump Festival 14.

## Live demos

- /showcase/pitch-critic — Pitch Critic. Six curated ideas, each spoken aloud
  via AIsa AIsa Chat streaming. Built in one Lovable prompt as proof of the
  5-credit budget.
